tools.label: LOCAL TOOLS / MCP
tools.description: Connect a remote MCP client to local files, shell commands, and persistent processes. Approve your device and workspace in the browser. Add the stable MCP URL to your client.
tools.note: Local execution requires your approval. File tools use workspace boundaries; shell commands run under your OS account without a workspace sandbox.
agents.label: REMOTE AGENTS / IN DEVELOPMENT
agents.description: Remote Agent integration is in development. The npm release verified for this page, 0.6.1, lacks Agent install and invoke commands.
agents.note: The planned flow preserves your host’s model provider configuration and invokes a hosted Frely Agent. Installation instructions require a verified supporting release.
models.label: LOCAL MODELS / PROVIDERS
models.description: Connect a running Ollama or another loopback OpenAI-compatible runtime as a personal Frely Provider. Use it through your existing Frely Access Points and API keys.
models.note: Requires a running local model and an empty, active personal Provider slot. Local MCP execution requires separate authorization.
install.description: Start with the commands: install or update, sign in, and connect your local tools.
source.description: Frely CLI and this page are open source. Explore the code, report an issue, or contribute a change.
source.note: The CLI connects to Frely’s hosted Relay service. The open-source client and local MCP runtime are licensed under Apache-2.0; use of Frely trademarks is subject to the trademark policy.
footer.note: Cloud AI, connected to your computer
copy.failure: Copy unavailable. The command is selected; use your device’s copy action.
tools.prepare: Run these commands inside the folder you intend to share. Complete device and workspace approval in your browser. Keep this computer running with an internet connection.
tools.connect: Add the exact URL printed by frely mcp url to a remote MCP client that supports OAuth. Select OAuth and complete the client’s authorization flow.
tools.verify: Ask Frely to list the top-level names in your selected workspace with the directory-reading tool, without file writes or shell execution. Match the returned names to that folder to verify the connection.
tools.diagnostics: If the call fails, run frely doctor --mcp and frely mcp service status. Diagnostics check credentials and service status; connection verification requires client OAuth authorization and a tool call.
models.verify: Send a request to the selected model through a Frely Access Point with its API key. Use the model’s reply to verify inference; the Provider list records registration status.
install.diagnostics: Check scope: CLI and account setup. Connection verification requires client OAuth authorization and a result returned by the tool.
install.next: Choose a workflow, complete its setup, and verify a tool result or model response.
